en: A black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a romantic landscape along a river. In the center background rises a dramatic line of steep, jagged rock formations covered with scattered trees, with dense forested hills behind them. On the left is a large riverside building with arched windows, possibly a hotel or Kurhaus, with promenading figures in 19th‑century clothing. At the lower left inset, several rowboats are moored at the riverbank as elegantly dressed people board or disembark. On the right, a curving path follows the river through tall conifers while a small boat with passengers moves along the water. Handwritten captions run faintly along the top margin, and at the lower left the artist's signature and a place name are visible.
